subsystems.title: Ring buffer, PM4 decoding, indirect buffers, waits and interrupts
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Packet encodings and register effects are Xenos-facing; worker scheduling, logging, sleep/yield policy and unsupported-opcode handling are ReXGlue choices.
subsystems.backend_boundary: The base CommandProcessor decodes packets. D3D12CommandProcessor implements draw, copy, swap and host query operations.

subsystems.title: GPU register file, writes, coherency and dirty state
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Register indices and bit layouts are Xenos data; the generated table, extended map and per-backend dirty-state policy are implementation structures.

subsystems.title: Draw triggers, extents, topology, indices, predication and queries
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Primitive types, reset indices and query packets are Xenos semantics; conversion algorithms, fake-query fallback and dropped unsupported immediate-index draws are ReXGlue behavior.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Base packet parsing builds IndexBufferInfo. Common PrimitiveProcessor converts unsupported topology; D3D12 binds and issues DrawInstanced/DrawIndexedInstanced.

subsystems.title: Vertex fetch, formats, endian and index conversion
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Fetch constants, formats and endian modes are Xenos-facing; shared-memory SRVs and topology expansion are host adaptation.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Shader analysis is common; D3D12 UpdateBindings requests shared ranges and creates descriptors, while D3D12PrimitiveProcessor owns converted host buffers.

subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Tiling, packed mips, formats, endian and fetch constants are Xenos concepts; compute conversion shaders, cache limits and D3D12 sampler approximations are implementation decisions.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Common code derives layouts, keys and watches. D3D12 creates resources and runs format/untiling load shaders.

symbols.role: derives common texture binding information

subsystems.title: Render targets, depth/stencil, EDRAM, MSAA, resolves and clears

subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: EDRAM tiles, formats, MSAA and copy registers are Xenos-facing; host-render-target ownership transfers and the ROV custom output-merger are alternative ReXGlue mappings.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Common RenderTargetCache computes attachment use, tile extents and ownership. D3D12 executes barriers, transfers, clears and resolve compute/direct paths.

unresolved: The runtime-selected Fable path is unproven: default D3D12 policy chooses host RTV for non-Intel and ROV for Intel when supported, but configuration may override it.
Fable MSAA, aliasing, clear and resolve patterns are unknown.

subsystems.title: Xenos shader loading, analysis, translation and caches
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Microcode and fetch/ALU/export semantics are Xenos; analysis structures, modification keys, DXBC generation and cache file formats are ReXGlue.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Shader::AnalyzeUcode and ShaderTranslator are common. DxbcShaderTranslator and D3D12Shader are current-backend-specific; SPIR-V is excluded from the current DLL.

subsystems.title: Host pipeline state, descriptors, constants and invalidation
outputs: host draw readiness or asynchronous skip
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: Xenos render state and constants are inputs; PSO decomposition, root signatures, descriptor strategy and asynchronous creation are host implementation policy.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Common analysis feeds D3D12 PipelineCache and D3D12CommandProcessor binding code. Vulkan owns separate cache/binding machinery and is not in the DLL.

subsystems.title: Shared memory, watches, resource lifetime, barriers, queues and fences
subsystems.xenos_vs_rexglue: A coherent 512 MiB physical space is the emulated target; page bitmaps, watch callbacks, sparse allocation, upload pools and fence retirement are ReXGlue/D3D12 mechanisms.
subsystems.backend_boundary: Common SharedMemory owns validity and watches. D3D12SharedMemory owns resources, transitions and uploads; D3D12CommandProcessor owns submission fences and reclamation.

symbols.role: makes guest ranges resident/current for GPU consumers

subsystems.title: Bounded Xbox system-UI integration with host presentation
